stem: On 1 April 2025, five businesses subscribed to Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, paid €40, €40, €60, €80 and €30 a month. On 1 April 2026 the same five pay €40, €65, €0 (cancelled), €50 and €30. No other business is in the cohort. What is their 12-month gross revenue retention (GRR)? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
